limitations: Odd prime fields, exponent-p Heisenberg groups, center-affine maps with linear quotient component. The n=1 case is prior-classified; higher-rank priority remains conditional on further historical review.
scientific_integrity: Constrained finite-group classification proved by direct identities and classical symplectic counting; low-dimensional direct checks are corroboration only. No claim of all group operators, unrestricted extraspecial types, independent verification or absolute historical priority.
title: Symplectic-similitude and isotropic-image phases of finite Heisenberg Rota–Baxter operators
